LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.klDiv_bind_le_sum: For probability weights rᵢ and a finite collection of distributions Pᵢ,Qᵢ on a finite discrete alphabet, D(∑ᵢ rᵢPᵢ ∥ ∑ᵢ rᵢQᵢ) ≤ ∑ᵢ rᵢD(Pᵢ∥Qᵢ), allowing infinite divergences and zero weights.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.toReal_klDiv_bind: Take finitely many pairs of laws Pᵢ,Qᵢ on a common finite discrete alphabet with probability weights rᵢ. Suppose supp(Pᵢ) ⊆ supp(Qᵢ) for each i with rᵢ > 0. This ensures the mixture divergence is finite. Its real value D(∑ᵢ rᵢPᵢ ∥ ∑ᵢ rᵢQᵢ) is at most the sum of rᵢD(Pᵢ∥Qᵢ) over those positive-weight components.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.klDiv_binaryMixtu: For 0 ≤ t ≤ 1 and finite discrete laws, D(tP₁+(1−t)P₂ ∥ tQ₁+(1−t)Q₂) ≤ tD(P₁∥Q₁)+(1−t)D(P₂∥Q₂), with extended divergences and zero-weight terms interpreted as zero.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.toReal_klDiv_bina: Let P₁, P₂, Q₁ and Q₂ be laws on the same finite discrete alphabet, and let 0 ≤ t ≤ 1. Assume supp(P₁) ⊆ supp(Q₁) when t > 0 and supp(P₂) ⊆ supp(Q₂) when t < 1. These assumptions ensure the mixture divergence is finite. Its real value D(tP₁+(1−t)P₂ ∥ tQ₁+(1−t)Q₂) is at most tD(P₁∥Q₁)+(1−t)D(P₂∥Q₂), omitting zero-weight terms.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.klDiv_binaryMixtu: For 0 < t < 1 and finite discrete pairs with supp(Pᵢ) ⊆ supp(Qᵢ) for i=1,2, equality holds in binary joint convexity of extended KL divergence exactly when P₁(x)Q₂(x) = P₂(x)Q₁(x) for every x.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.toReal_klDiv_bina: For 0 < t < 1 and finite discrete pairs with supp(Pᵢ) ⊆ supp(Qᵢ) for i=1,2, the real KL divergence between the two mixtures equals tD(P₁∥Q₁)+(1−t)D(P₂∥Q₂) exactly when P₁(x)Q₂(x) = P₂(x)Q₁(x) at every x.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.mutualInfo_channe: For finite alphabets, input law p and channel W, I(X;Y) = H(Y) − ∑ₓ p(x)H(W(·|x)), where Y is the output obtained by passing X through W.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.sum_mul_mutualInf: For a fixed finite channel W and a finite mixture of input laws Pᵢ with weights rᵢ, the mutual information at the mixed input is at least ∑ᵢ rᵢ I(Pᵢ;W).
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.mutualInfo_binary: At fixed finite channel W and 0 ≤ t ≤ 1, I(tP+(1−t)Q;W) ≥ t I(P;W)+(1−t)I(Q;W), where I(P;W) denotes input–output mutual information under input P.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.mutualInfo_channe: Let Wᵢ be a finite family of channels with common finite input and output alphabets, and let the weights rᵢ sum to one with rᵢ ≥ 0. For a fixed input law p, mixing the channel rows with these weights gives mutual information at most ∑ᵢ rᵢ I(p;Wᵢ).
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.mutualInfo_binary: Let W₁ and W₂ be channels with the same finite input and output alphabets. For a fixed input law p and 0 ≤ t ≤ 1, mixing the two output laws at each input gives I(p;tW₁+(1−t)W₂) ≤ tI(p;W₁)+(1−t)I(p;W₂).
